findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council recognized 911 dispatchers, emergency personnel, and local employees for their lifesaving actions during a cardiac arrest call. Council members then addressed business items including approving an electrical transmission easement, rejecting a fire station bay construction bid due to excessive cost, and approving a police vehicle purchase.
